name: Burpees
description: Explosive movement combining squat, plank, push-up, and vertical jump. One of the most demanding bodyweight exercises for conditioning.

name: 6-Count Burpees
description: Structured burpee with 6 distinct counts: squat down, kick back, push-up down, push-up up, jump feet forward, jump up. Enforces proper form and pacing.

name: Navy Seal Burpees
description: Intense burpee variation with push-up, adding a mountain climber or extra push-up. Used in military training for extreme conditioning.

name: Push-ups
description: Classic upper body exercise pushing body up from floor. Builds chest, shoulder, and tricep strength while engaging core for stability.
formTips: Lower until chest nearly touches floor

name: Pull-ups
description: Hanging from bar, pull body up until chin clears. Gold standard for back and bicep development.

name: Squats
description: Bend knees and hips to lower body, then stand. Fundamental leg movement essential for daily activities.

name: Lunges
description: Step forward and lower back knee toward ground. Excellent for single-leg strength and balance.

name: Plank
description: Hold push-up position with forearms on ground. Isometric exercise building core endurance and stability.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: From plank, rapidly alternate driving knees toward chest. Combines core work with cardio.

name: Jumping Jacks
description: Jump spreading legs and raising arms, then return. Classic cardio that elevates heart rate quickly.

name: Dips
description: Lower body between parallel bars by bending elbows, then push up. Excellent tricep and chest builder.

name: Sit-ups
description: Lying on back, curl torso toward knees. Classic core exercise targeting the abdominals.

name: Glute Bridges
description: Lying with knees bent, drive hips upward squeezing glutes. Activates posterior chain.

name: Superman
description: Lying face down, lift arms and legs off ground simultaneously. Strengthens lower back and glutes.

name: Leg Raises
description: Lying on back, raise straight legs to vertical, then lower. Targets lower abs.

name: High Knees
description: Run in place driving knees as high as possible. Cardio that builds hip flexor strength.

name: Jump Squats
description: Explosively jump from squat position. Builds power and fast-twitch muscle fibers.

name: Diamond Push-ups
description: Push-up with hands together forming diamond. Shifts emphasis to triceps.

name: Inverted Rows
description: Hang from low bar, pull chest to bar with body straight. Horizontal pulling for back strength.

name: Pistol Squats
description: Single-leg squat with other leg extended forward. Advanced exercise requiring strength and balance.

name: Wall Sit
description: Hold seated position against wall, thighs parallel to floor. Isometric leg endurance.

name: Bear Crawl
description: Crawl on hands and feet with knees hovering. Full-body coordination and core stability.
